scope: Cold selection and 24 native moves per appearance gesture. rAF execution/longtasks are scheduling proxies, not pointer-to-paint. Raw rAF intervals permit comparison with 16.7ms; no 60fps promise. Short cold-selection input may be insufficient; its release-to-presence window captures setup. Only after the final move, two rAF boundaries precede the DOM-value sample while input observation continues; this adds a final presentation opportunity, not intermediate throttling or photon measurement. No profiler overhead. Driver completion timeline uses a separate process clock.
